build.beforeDevCommand: bun run prepare:sidecar && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run prepare:sidecar --release && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://image.tmdb.org; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; media-src blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://image.tmdb.org; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:1420 ws://localhost:1420 http://127.0.0.1:*; media-src blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
